typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 9 / statusLabel.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 9 / page.

recognitionRules: Lead with a room outline and a clearly reserved strip; retain the same object inventory across alternatives.
Use monospaced dimensions and object labels beside plain sans-serif explanations.
Give concept-only status a stable visible position near the title.
Align plan drawings to a shared scale before comparing benefits.

principles: Name the spatial condition, comparison and uncertainty with precise physical language.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Two arrangements. The same room. A clearer next test.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid implying that a concept drawing is a construction specification.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: The same room can support two different arrangements.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use ROOM STUDY in spaced Arial capitals beside a simple open rectangular corner. Avoid building silhouettes and implied construction certification.
invariants: Lead with a room outline and a clearly reserved strip; retain the same object inventory across alternatives.
Use monospaced dimensions and object labels beside plain sans-serif explanations.
Give concept-only status a stable visible position near the title.
adaptations: Large boards may pair plans horizontally; narrow pages stack them at the same scale.
Reduce illustration detail before shrinking dimension labels.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Courier New is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
